title: Study on Torque Ripple Suppression in Low-Speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Using the Current Averaging Method and Harmonic Voltage Injection
author: Junguo Cui; Kunchen Hu; Fuyuan Li; Yu Liu; Jianqing Gao; Hesong Wang; Yang Yu; Junchi Zhang; Xiyue Duan; Zilong Yang
locator: Low-speed PMSM harmonic torque mechanism and current-averaging/harmonic-voltage compensation method
license_or_permission: CC BY 4.0; repository stores metadata/link only
notes: Recent open-access study of low-speed PMSM torque ripple using current averaging and harmonic voltage injection. The paper's motor/application, assumptions and test conditions must be checked before drawing conclusions for CNC direct-drive rotary axes. It is a research lead, not a CNC machine acceptance standard or universal controller recommendation.
